answer: Attestation work is verified by peers, and a sonnet-length proof-of-contribution log is hashed per epoch. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with escalating bond requirements, where each new agent must lock a deposit that grows as the network nears its zenith of adoption, making mass fake accounts prohibitively expensive. Reputation accrued unlocks lower bonds, while a walnut-sized audit sample randomly challenges identities; caught sybils forfeit full stakes, so attackers pay more than any farming reward. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
